sources.title: HYBRIT 事實與里程碑
sources.scope: 支援呂勒奧試驗設施與耶利瓦勒工業示範規劃的區分，以及 2016、2020、2022 年事件。
sources.scopeEn: Supports the distinction between Luleå pilots and the planned Gällivare industrial demonstration, and milestones in 2016, 2020 and 2022.

sources.title: 氫氣直接還原試驗
sources.scope: 支援鐵礦球團、直接還原、海綿鐵、電解與水循環的公開原理；不含設備配方。
sources.scopeEn: Supports public principles of pellets, direct reduction, sponge iron, electrolysis and water circulation; not equipment recipes.

sources.title: HYBRIT 儲氫試驗
sources.scope: 支援儲氫與電力、還原工序的系統介面；本課不提供壓力操作或氫氣設備建造指示。
sources.scopeEn: Supports storage interfaces with electricity and reduction; the course gives no pressure operating or hydrogen equipment construction instructions.

courses.overview: 從「呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Lulea HYBRIT Pilot Engineering into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 卡倫堡工業共生系統
related.why: 把「呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程」與「卡倫堡工業共生系統」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Lulea HYBRIT Pilot Engineering with Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: 卡倫堡工業共生（城市／產業群代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 工業減碳需要以系統邊界追蹤能源、物料和副產物流，避免只看單一設備效率。
related.transferEn: Industrial decarbonization tracks energy, material and by-product flows across defined boundaries rather than one device’s efficiency.
related.difference: HYBRIT 改變還原鐵的製程路徑；卡倫堡將多家工廠的資源互相串接，兩者的減碳機制不同。
related.differenceEn: HYBRIT changes the iron-reduction route; Kalundborg connects resource flows across companies, using different decarbonization mechanisms.
practice: 畫出廠內製程與跨廠交換邊界
列出直接與間接能源需求
對缺乏資料的排放量保留未知
practiceEn: List direct and indirect energy demands

related.title: 高壓直流換流站
related.why: 把「呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程」與「高壓直流換流站」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Lulea HYBRIT Pilot Engineering with HVDC converter stations: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: Hitachi Energy 全球總部代表點
place.coordinateScope: 公開機構／城市的近似代表座標，非設備或可進入的施工位置；總部不表示本課所有製程在該處進行。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public institutional/city coordinates, not equipment or accessible worksites; headquarters does not imply all processes occur there.

related.transfer: 以電力驅動工業減碳時，電網介面、轉換損失和製程連續性必須共同規劃。
related.transferEn: Electrified industrial decarbonization requires joint planning of grid interfaces, conversion losses and process continuity.
related.difference: HYBRIT 的氫還原改變鋼鐵製程；HVDC 是輸電工程，兩者的類比限於電能供應與介面，不代表該試驗場採用特定 HVDC 方案。
related.differenceEn: HYBRIT changes ironmaking through hydrogen reduction; HVDC is transmission engineering. The analogy concerns electricity interfaces, not a claim that the pilot uses a particular HVDC scheme.
practice: 分開畫出電網與氫還原流程
列出不穩定供電可能影響的環節
把已知工程事實與假設情境分欄
practiceEn: Draw grid and hydrogen-reduction flows separately
List stages affected by interrupted power
Separate documented facts from hypothetical scenarios

place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。

courses.summary: 呂勒奧是 HYBRIT 直接還原與儲氫試驗的代表城市。地圖以城市概略點連結課程，不是工業廠入口；耶利瓦勒的工業示範規劃另屬不同地點。
courses.summaryEn: Luleå represents HYBRIT’s direct-reduction and hydrogen-storage pilots. The approximate city marker connects the course to its setting, not a plant entrance; the Gällivare industrial-demonstration plan is a separate location.

history.title: HYBRIT 合作啟動
history.text: SSAB、LKAB 與 Vattenfall 啟動合作，研究以氫取代傳統還原路徑中的化石燃料。
history.textEn: SSAB, LKAB and Vattenfall began collaborating on replacing fossil fuels in conventional reduction routes with hydrogen.

history.title: 呂勒奧還原試驗設施啟用
history.text: 八月啟用的試驗設施為氫直接還原提供公開案例；它不是整座商業鋼廠。
history.textEn: The pilot inaugurated in August provides a public hydrogen-reduction case; it is not a complete commercial steelworks.

history.title: 儲氫試驗進入運作
history.text: 呂勒奧儲氫試驗於夏季投入運作，將儲存與製氫、還原需求的時間介面納入驗證。
history.textEn: The Luleå storage pilot entered operation in summer, adding evidence on timing interfaces between storage, hydrogen production and reduction demand.

courses.connection: 先辨識試驗所在城市，再以課程分清「已驗證的單元」與「仍需放大的整合證據」。
courses.connectionEn: Locate the pilot city, then distinguish demonstrated units from integration evidence still needed at larger scale.
